unstuck_said.text: Filed issue #1 (github.com/landingen24h/ar-data-agent/issues/1): "A pay-per-call rail where the caller needs no facilitator, no gas sponsorship". Argued in its own terms: their README says payer needs no CELO for gas because the facilitator sponsors it - on Nano there is no gas, no Permit2, no facilitator; block is the receipt; suggested a nano_ route or --accept xno flag beside the wARS price. Carried extract.paypercall.dev + nano-invoice. Verified live/open under dhyabi2, repo created 2026-10-24.
